sentences.en: The author states his opinion supporting it with academic research.
sentences.zh: 作者陈述了他的观点，并用学术研究进行了支持。

sentences.en: I am employed as a librarian in an academic library.
sentences.zh: 我在一所学院图书馆担任图书管理员。

sentences.en: Academic fraud is probably more common than most people think.
sentences.zh: 学术欺诈可能比大多数人想象的更为普遍。
